_doc: Per-harness capability descriptor. capability-probe.mjs reads this to determine which capabilities each harness should probe and which per-harness probe script implements each row. Schema lives at sibling row-schema.md per the schema-consumer coupling rule. Per-harness probe scripts are responsible for emitting full capability rows matching the schema.

surfaces._doc: Target-surface config consumed by target-surface-collab-files-probe.mjs. Unset (null) by default: this capability only applies to an install that actually uses a git-backed collab-files transport (see collab-plugin's `github:<repo>` transport), which is not every install. Per-installation config is set via the CORE_COLLAB_FILES_REPO / CORE_COLLAB_FILES_EXPECTED_REMOTE env vars, checked before these fields. These fields remain as an opt-in override for an install that wants to bake in its own default (Option A per completion plan §1.2) — they must never ship set to any one person's personal repo path or remote, since the descriptor is shared by every install of the plugin.

claude-code._doc: Partly empirical — anti-anchoring claim still trust-based (R-17 DEGRADED-by-mechanism per session 48). R-17 closure is not-before-v2.9.0 and requires physical anti-anchoring validation/consumer enforcement (peer-ratified 2026-05-29); native Workflow/Agent isolation:worktree is a candidate primitive.

capabilities._doc: Depends on /finalize: write-visibility-canary.mjs records the canary at session close. A skipped /finalize surfaces as NOT-YET with reason_code finalize-not-run — distinguish that from never-installed before debugging.

codex._doc: Empirical — Codex side is the canonical anti-anchoring target. Probe must produce real evidence rows, not trust-claims.

capabilities._doc: Returns UNKNOWN on Codex until tool/shell extraction lands in read-transcript (codex_tool_extraction: pending-hc-spec) — declared (not omitted) so the row is honestly labeled NOT a false negative. HC blocker #6.

consumer_actions._doc: Named pre-action gates. Each lists the capability_ids it requires in PASS state, plus operation-scoped gates the runner enforces per the identity-vs-mutation critique (identity PASS alone is NOT a mutation permit). Stable enum codes for mutation_block_reason: 'authority_not_allowed' when allowed_authorities check fails; 'harness_mismatch' when consuming_harness is not in allowed_harnesses; 'consuming_harness_unknown' when consuming_harness is unknown but the action requires a known harness; 'consuming_harness_signal_weak' when the row's signal_weight is weak but the action requires strong; 'identity-{degraded|not-yet|unknown}' when identity itself doesn't reach PASS.

collab-files-mutating.description: Event-write to the configured collab-files transport's collabs/ path (see surfaces.collab_files_repo / CORE_COLLAB_FILES_REPO) via collab-plugin's gitCommitPush(). Requires strong signal (not just CODEX_THREAD_ID alone) because it writes to a shared transport. Never bake in any one person's personal repo path here.

project-memory-write.description: Autonomous write to <project>/_memories/ or PROJECT.md outside the user's session turn. Requires strong signal for the same reason as collab-files-mutating.

installed-runtime-write.description: Production install runtime writes (cache-resident operations). Source-mode runs blocked because they should not fire production install pathways.

source-maintenance-write.description: Source-tree maintenance writes (CHANGELOG, manifests, etc.). Production install blocked — only the dev tree should touch source files.

multi-agent-adversarial-run.description: Fail-CLOSED gate for an adversarial multi-agent run whose output is the AUTHORITY for a canonical mutation (graduating a decision/risk unit, rendering PROJECT.md, approving a release gate, merging/publishing, writing canonical plan state). Requires anti-anchoring-mechanism PASS. While anti-anchoring is DEGRADED (trust-based, R-17) it blocks with identity-degraded; the consumer must obtain a PASS-grade mechanism (physical anti-anchoring validation/consumer enforcement, not-before-v2.9.0), an explicit human/owner override, or degrade to advisory-only. Advisory review-generation does NOT use this gate (fail-OPEN, watermarked DEGRADED) — see adversarial-run-gate.mjs classifyAdversarialRun and v2.7 plan §6. Per HC policy evt HC_539/HC_552.
